BLD.Settings.DeepBleed.Name: Deep Bleed (homebrew)
BLD.Settings.DeepBleed.Hint: HOMEBREW. Allows a bleed to be inflicted as a deep wound: it cannot be stopped by removing the bleed condition, and closes only once a set number of hit points of dedicated healing have been spent on it — healing that would otherwise have gone to the character's hit points. Requires pf1-critical-effects, which supplies the dedicated-healing allocation dialog. Turning this off stops new deep bleeds; any already inflicted stay payable so nobody is left with a wound that cannot be closed.

BLD.Settings.SavePrompt.Name: Reflex save vs. burning
BLD.Settings.SavePrompt.Hint: When on, a burning creature may attempt a Reflex save at the start of its turn to put out the flames. When off, no save is prompted — a burning creature automatically takes 1d6 fire damage at the end of each of its turns until the burning condition is removed. This is a master switch: individual burnings can also be applied without a save while this is on.
BLD.Settings.Resistance.Name: Burning respects fire resistance
BLD.Settings.Resistance.Hint: When on, burning damage is reduced by the target's fire resistance (highest applicable, as resistances of the same type don't stack) and increased by 50% against creatures vulnerable to fire. When off, the 1d6 is applied flat, like bleed. Fire immunity is always respected either way.
